content.title: Blink Joins Select Group Of US Companies With Key EV Charger Certification
content.summary: Blink Charging Co. (NASDAQ:BLNK) said Tuesday its Series 7, 8, and 9 chargers have earned Open Charge Point Protocol (OCPP) 2.0.1 certification, a distinction granted by the Open Charge Alliance. The designation makes Blink one of just five U.S. companies to meet the standard, underscoring its role in advancing electric vehicle infrastructure.
